description: A written word that is spelled letter by letter is one word slot in DECtalk's parse of a stretch (LTS/ls_task.c:5066-5075: a slot is what stands between two white spaces), so the clause breaks before a conjunction or a preposition are counted with it as one word. From the third messy sweep's m3-142.
